stem:
Customers at a gift shop receive free stickers for every T-shirt they buy. The graph shows the relationship between x, the number of T-shirts customers buy, and y, the number of stickers customers receive.

Which table also represents this relationship?

options.label: F
options.text:

6 | 6
7 | 7
8 | 8
9 | 9

14 | 7
18 | 9

Four tables labeled F, H, G, and J each with two columns labeled 'Number of T-Shirts Bought' and 'Number of Free Stickers' with respective values as listed in options
